description.content:
Lists the Test Results of the Workspace according to the method parameters.
___
*Sortable fields :*
  - name
  - project
  - startDate (descending sort by default : the most recent first)
  - qualityStatus

query.description: Returns only the Test Results with the specified status.
Project name. Returns only the Test Results of the specified project.
The author of the Test Result. Returns only the Test Results launched by the specified author.
The maximum number of elements returned by this call. The maximum must be less than or equal to 200.
The offset of the first element to return. Starting at this offset, the query will return a maximum of 'limit' elements.
The key to sort the elements on. It may begin with a '+' or a '-' to specify an ascending or descending sort order. The list of available keys can be found in the endpoint description.
Comma-separated list of fields to include in the json Test Result definition.
If true the Json returned is human readable.
